categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo GQY Video & Telecom Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the intelligent splicing display product sector, focusing on R&D, production, and sales of Mini LED/Micro LED splicing, DLP splicing, and LCD splicing products. The company also engages in system integration services, providing digital, information, and intelligent solutions for various industries including emergency management, smart education, public security, transportation, and smart cities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as Mini LED, Micro LED, DLP, and LCD display technologies integrated with big data, cloud computing, AI, and IoT. It has developed proprietary systems like the DMS screen operating system and full-matrix digital operation and maintenance system, enhancing intelligent control and management of large screen splicing displays. Production follows ISO quality management standards with strict quality control and testing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, public security departments, energy companies, transportation sectors, education institutions, and large enterprises. Major projects involve smart emergency command, smart city infrastructure, smart education, and digital government applications. The company’s products serve diverse markets such as command and dispatch centers, conference services, exhibition displays, sports events, and digital government platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with offices and production facilities in Zhejiang (Ningbo), Shanghai, and Henan (Kaifeng). Its sales cover multiple Chinese regions including East China, Southwest, South China, North China, Northwest, Northeast, and Central China, with significant revenue contributions from Northeast and Central China regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo GQY operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the LED display supply chain, focusing on product assembly, system integration, and solution delivery. It procures raw materials and components such as display panels, LED modules, processors, and metal structures from suppliers and assembles them into finished splicing display systems and integrated solutions for end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation and product upgrading, focusing on high-resolution, high-color saturation, and AI-enabled intelligent display solutions. Key R&D projects include development of large language model platforms for video business support, smart education systems, remote maintenance platforms, LED electromagnetic shielding units, and domestic splicing control system localization. It aims to expand into smart education, smart tourism, and other emerging digital sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of intelligent splicing display systems and system integration services including hardware installation, software sales, and technical support. The company operates on an order-driven 'make-to-order' basis with a combination of direct sales and channel distribution. Additional income comes from government subsidies, investment income, and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading professional audio-video and high-resolution visualization technology solution provider in China’s intelligent splicing display industry. It leverages over 30 years of industry experience, comprehensive product lines, and strong government and enterprise customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages in technology, service, and market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 140.7 million, a 4.23% increase from 2023, but incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.7 million, worsening from the previous year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.05 billion with net assets of RMB 931 million. Despite losses, the company is investing in R&D with expenditures of RMB 9.1 million (6.46% of revenue) and expanding system integration business, which grew 91.12% in revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo GQY emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering full series of intelligent splicing displays with high brightness, resolution, and color accuracy, combined with proprietary intelligent operating systems that simplify complex display management. The company offers customized, multi-dimensional solutions tailored to diverse industry needs, backed by robust after-sales service and strong quality assurance. Its strategic focus on innovation, system integration, and deep industry expertise differentiates it in the competitive visualization display market.
